violated_contract: A deploy's acceptance probe must reach the candidate through a path the service's own network policy admits. When the deployment contract restricts Cloud Run ingress to internal or load-balancer traffic, a probe aimed at the tagged run.app candidate URL answers 404 to CI regardless of authentication, so every promotion fails with a misleading 'canary did not become ready' and the service silently stops shipping while merges keep landing.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the acceptance route from the same contract that sets ingress: open ingress smokes the tagged no-traffic candidate before promotion; restricted ingress requires a declared public URL and is smoked after promotion with automatic rollback; any other combination fails naming the ingress policy as the cause.
